messages:
Tess (Support): Heads-up: Vertex staging is seeing embed rate limits and proxy 502s while running their onboarding validation. They've paused the flow and flagged this as impacting their conversion week. Logs pasted below.

Tess (Support): ```
2026-03-29T21:10:02Z embed-proxy status=429 tenant=vertex env=staging pool=us-east-2
2026-03-29T21:11:19Z gateway status=502 upstream=embed-proxy tenant=vertex
```

incident-bot: New incident VTX-INC-1024 created (priority: P2) - elevated embed errors for tenant vertex (staging).

Marco - CSM: Marco here. Vertex is in conversion week and demo later today. Can Support confirm whether prod is affected and capture customer sentiment?

Tess (Support): Only staging impacted. Error rate ~28% across the last 18m. Customer was "frustrated" and stopped the automated checks. They asked for a short remediation plan and ETA.

Renee - CS Ops: Looping SRE. Renee will own the customer note and renewal flag. Jon, any initial thoughts?

Jon (SRE): No infra/model deploys for Vertex in >72h. Traces show a CI test runner hammering staging with many tiny requests (concurrency ~130), backpressure caused queue spill and 502s. Quick mitigations: (1) temp per-tenant concurrency bump, (2) optionally allowlist their staging IP range for 30m, (3) mute alerts while monitoring. Long-term: quota and batching recommendations. Trace: trace/vtx/1825001234.

Marco - CSM: Proposed comms to buyer: "Hi Jordan , we saw transient embed errors in your staging run tied to a CI burst. We've applied a temporary stabilization and are monitoring; prod is unaffected. ETA for reversion: 45m. We can rerun your onboarding checks and offer a short enablement call to optimize your test runner. Apologies for the interruption." Thoughts?

Jon (SRE): Recommend adding: "If this traffic pattern will be repeated in production, we can propose a quota plan to support it." Also apply the concurrency bump now.

Tess (Support): Applied temp bump at 21:17 UTC (concurrency 10->40) and muted alerts for 40m. Error rate dropped to ~3% within 6m.

Renee - CS Ops: Sending comms now and adding a renewal playbook entry: "staging embed >10% during onboarding -> escalate support->CS, apply temp mitigation, offer enablement, log sentiment." I'll link VTX-INC-1024.

Marco - CSM: Sent message to Jordan. @Tess please capture customer reply and tone; @Sam please prepare a 20m enablement slot.

Sam (Enablement): I'll DM Marco two slots and prepare a short checklist on batching/backoff to attach.

incident-bot: VTX-INC-1024 status -> monitoring (updates: 21:23 UTC, 21:27 UTC).

Tess (Support): Customer reply: "Thanks Marco , staging looks stable. We'll take an enablement call and throttle our CI. Appreciate the quick response." Tone: relieved.

Marco - CSM: Marking resolved for now. Follow-ups: (1) Renee to add renewal note and link incident, (2) Sam to run pairing and attach checklist, (3) SRE to revert cap at 21:57 UTC unless extended, (4) if customer requests permanent quota, open ops/pricing ticket and update renewal risk.

Renee - CS Ops: Added renewal note: "staging embed burst -> transient friction, mitigated quickly; enablement scheduled; monitor conversion risk." Also created a small RFC to add a short 'staging best practices' blurb to onboarding docs.

Jon (SRE): Reversion scheduled for 21:57 UTC. Will reopen incident if error rate spikes after revert. Trace and notes attached to VTX-INC-1024.

Marco - CSM: Thanks team. I'll update the conversion tracker and include a one-line note in the next renewal sync deck.
